Athletics Coach Mohammad Yunus Khan Suspended in NADA Doping Probe

Mohammad Yunus Khan, the former coach of athlete Gulveer Singh, has been provisionally suspended by the National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA) in connection with a doping probe. The suspension is related to an investigation into doping violations.
